body: As I look around, I notice a group of people gathered near the edge of the room, their eyes fixed on a figure at the forefront of the crowd. My heart skips a beat as I realize that the figure is me, standing tall and proud, with a smile that seems to be directed straight at me. But it's not me, it's someone else, a stranger who has somehow been substituted in my place. My initial reaction is fear, a strong and primal response that urges me to avoid this situation at all costs.
